base_prompt:
FULL-FRAME ILLUSTRATION (not a sprite): a widescreen 16:9 LANDSCAPE image with its own complete background, no transparency. No text, no letters, no captions, no logos, no watermark, no speech bubbles, no UI.
MAIN CHARACTER (must match the attached reference exactly: face, white hair, big full white beard, black sunglasses, red Santa hat with white fur trim, comically over-muscular SHIRTLESS body, red pants with white fur cuffs, black boots, the same semi-realistic cel-shaded cartoon style with a thick dark navy outline). He keeps wearing ONLY the red hat, sunglasses, red pants and black boots (no shirt, no jacket, no belt) unless the scene says otherwise.
Composition: the character is the clear hero, placed in the LEFT or RIGHT third of the frame (NOT dead center, leave the middle area relatively calm because a menu will be placed over it), large and readable. Anatomically correct: exactly two arms, two legs, five fingers per hand. Funny, dramatic, high-energy, rich colors, a clean readable background that supports the gag.

jobs.name: bg_01_barbell
jobs.prompt: SCENE: a gym. He stands on the LEFT side lifting a huge barbell overhead; the barbell plates are giant gift boxes wrapped in red and green paper with ribbons. Gym equipment and weight racks in the background, warm spotlights, sweat drops, a proud grin.

jobs.name: bg_02_sleigh
jobs.prompt: SCENE: a snowy night. He stands on the RIGHT side effortlessly lifting an entire loaded Santa sleigh (full of presents) over his head with ONE arm, as if it weighs nothing, while a few reindeer in the harness dangle comically in the air with surprised faces. Snowy village, starry sky, snowflakes.

jobs.name: bg_03_armwrestle
jobs.prompt: SCENE: an arm-wrestling match on a wooden table in a cozy cabin. He sits on the LEFT, relaxed and smirking, easily pinning the hoof of a sweating, struggling reindeer sitting opposite on the RIGHT edge of the frame. Warm lantern light, wood walls, Christmas decorations.

jobs.name: bg_04_tree_squat
jobs.prompt: SCENE: outdoors in snow. He does a deep barbell squat on the RIGHT side using a whole Christmas tree (with lights and ornaments still on it) across his shoulders as the barbell. Determined grin. Snowy forest background with falling snow, golden hour light.

jobs.name: bg_05_sack
jobs.prompt: SCENE: a snowy rooftop at night. He stands on the LEFT carrying a gigantic overflowing sack of presents slung over one shoulder with one hand, and giving a confident thumbs-up with the other hand. Chimneys and snowy rooftops, a huge full moon behind him.

jobs.name: bg_06_selfie
jobs.prompt: SCENE: a bright cheerful photo moment. He stands on the RIGHT taking a SELFIE: one arm extended holding a smartphone toward the viewer, the other arm flexing a big biceps, grinning. Pastel pink and blue background with sparkles and Christmas lights bokeh.

jobs.name: bg_07_disco
jobs.prompt: SCENE: a disco dance floor. He is dancing on the LEFT in a cool deadpan dance pose with one arm swung wide, a glittering disco ball, colorful beams of light, glowing floor tiles in rainbow colors, smoke, a party atmosphere.

jobs.name: bg_08_shaker
jobs.prompt: SCENE: a gym at sunset. He stands on the RIGHT chugging from an enormous protein shaker bottle that is full of milk and has cookies floating in it, milk dripping down his beard, other arm flexing. Warm orange light through the window, workout benches in the background.

jobs.name: bg_09_yeti
jobs.prompt: SCENE: a snowstorm on a mountain. He stands on the LEFT in a double-biceps flex staring down a huge angry white yeti who flexes back on the RIGHT edge of the frame, a funny competitive standoff, lightning-cold blue light, swirling snow.

jobs.name: bg_10_snowman_hide
jobs.prompt: SCENE: a snowy yard. He is on the RIGHT trying to HIDE behind a tiny, small snowman, crouching awkwardly with his huge muscular body obviously sticking out on both sides, wearing a tiny blue kid's knitted beanie with a yellow pom-pom on top of his hat-less head (no Santa hat in this scene), a sneaky 'nobody can see me' expression. Cozy houses with warm lit windows in the background.

jobs.name: bg_11_peak
jobs.prompt: SCENE: the summit of a snowy mountain at sunrise. He stands on the LEFT with both arms spread wide in triumph, wind blowing his white beard, a glowing green and purple aurora across the sky, golden sun rays on the horizon, epic and funny.

jobs.name: bg_12_hottub
jobs.prompt: SCENE: a steaming hot tub in the snow at night. He relaxes on the RIGHT in the water up to his chest (only his upper body is visible: shirtless chest, big arms resting on the tub edge, red hat and sunglasses on), holding a mug of hot cocoa with whipped cream, a peaceful smug smile. Snowflakes, steam, fairy lights, snowy pine trees.
